title: Kidney bean rajma with rice
summary: Kidney bean rajma with rice is a indian dinner built around canned red kidney beans and basmati rice, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Kidney bean rajma with rice. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add canned red kidney beans and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and basmati rice.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until chopped tomatoes is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Kidney bean rajma with rice before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Kidney bean rajma with rice.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
